name: mojulo-chatgpt
description: Build, edit, export and resume Mojulo recipes through connected MCP or a ChatGPT Work box.

interface.shortDescription: Create and resume 3D recipes with Mojulo.
interface.longDescription: Uses connected Mojulo MCP tools when available, or a pinned workspace-local CLI in a shell-enabled Work box. Includes portable recipe recovery guidance. This development package does not provision a box or host a public MCP endpoint.
defaultPrompt: Make a small 3D object with Mojulo and give me the editable recipe.
Resume my saved Mojulo recipe and change its proportions.
